cohort: The study included 998,675 live singleton cephalic births at term (>= 37 gestational weeks) from the Swedish Medical Birth Register between 1999 and 2011, excluding elective cesarean sections and fourth or more births.
finding: Maternal age is an independent risk factor for labor dystocia in first, second, and third births, with adjusted odds ratios progressively increasing from the youngest to the oldest age group irrespective of parity.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight was adjusted for, but not an inclusion criterion range)
